reviews.x: I bought this because of the positive reviews and it arrived quickly. (the product I usually get was out of stock) So I used this right away on myself and another nail tech tried it too, she loved it!  After about a week we hadn't run into any lifting issues with the base coat and the top coat was still nice and shiny. So I started using it on some clients and it has worked really well! Now after using it for a good 6 months I would definitely recommend DND base and top coat for most clients.  I

I feel that the DND gel nail polish does better using their base and top coat :) i will update my review in a few weeks to see how long my manicure lasts.  05-10-2021 UPDATE - So.... I haven’t used this base and top coat almost a year now. Now that I’m more knowledgeable when it comes down to nail service, this top coat and gel base isn’t the best. Consistency is quite thick. This product puddles a lot specially the top coat. Even with preparing the nail properly this product puddles on your nai

Love the product itself but when this arrived, the bottle of base coat was already solid. It wasn’t stored properly and so my brush got stuck and hardened in the bottle along with everything else in the bottle!

reviews.t: This is a MUST for your at home gel manicure
reviews.x: When using apply a very thin coat of base polish. Cure it 90 seconds. It will still.be a bit damp and sticky. But that good. Follow up with gel nail color. Same THIN coat. It may not be smooth. Again that's good. Cure it..90 seconds then apply another THIN layer are nail color. Too it off with your gel top coat. Thin layer! Cure, then another. Tip/Trick...they must be THIN layers.

reviews.t: Easy to use and works great
reviews.x: These coats are easy to use and work great. Only con is it feels really hot on the skin when put under light. Feels like a small burn but left no marks on skin. Be careful and accurate in application!
I don’t think this is authentic. Did not cure properly and smelled horrible. It went in the trash.
A bit dissapointed i recevied 2 top coats.

I personally use this with the nail dipping powder and it works great. Yes, the led light is needed. My nails have been done for 2 weeks and they can go another week. My nails are natural but in the pictures I also did apply a tip on a broken nail. I do maybe 4 or 5 dips and sometimes I use the DND,dip then Led and brush off the excess or sometimes I DND,led, then dip and brush off the excess. I find that when you dip before the led you get a thicker layer. Your nails are less likely to break wh

I’ve been doing my own gel nails for a long time, and thought I’d buy some CND this time as I knew it was good as the salon I used to visit (before doing my own) used this brand exclusively. I was so excited because it looked smooth and the brushes weren’t bent, but on almost half of my nails once cured under the light they were wavy and almost melted looking! I had to redo them and there was no rhyme or reason to which nail looked perfect and which looked horrible. I use several brands regularl

reviews.t: Thin formula but still my favorite!
reviews.x: Definitely my favorite top and base coat! It's incredibly solid and durable once fully cured. The only issue is the formula is a tad thin and the brushes hold A LOT of the polish. It takes some practice to not put too much on your nail, which affects how long your manicure lasts. I still recommend it over any other gel top and base coat.  Also, when I received the package, some of the product had spilled out onto the bottles. It wasn't much but it smelled HORRIBLE. It was almost 100 degrees out

I been a nail tech for 7 years and used no wipe gel for a very long time. I bought this no wipe top and base thinking it was a great product. I was absolutely wrong! This product doesn’t seal what’s so ever. Horrible!!!!!! A waste of money, I’m very upset. I literally had my client on the chair for nearly 3 hours thinking my gel polish was the problem. Once I switched to my cheaper brand it was like magic. The gel looked great and the top coat dried like it’s supposed to. Please please do not wa

This is such a great value!  They come in big bottles so you can get a lot of uses from these.  The first time I ordered, I bought the top coat that needs to be wiped afterwards but this time I bought the "no-cleanse" one.  That was a game changer!  I love that it is already and instantly shiny and ready to go.  I would highly recommend this.  It is a bit runny so you do have to be careful when applying to be sure that it doesn't pool on the sides.

reviews.t: THE BEST TOP AND BASE GEL COAT OUT THERE!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:c85aaf2b4a765dd4a2a5154026b7da27]] It is the best top and base coat I’ve ever had! In our salon we replaced all of our base and topcoat with this one. A little bit goes a long way if you use too much it will start to flood. Also you need to Cure for 60 seconds in an LED/UV lamp to get the right results. If you want to use chrome with it you can I just recommend curing it for only 10 seconds and then the chrome will stick to it amazingly!!

I was introduced to this product when I went to a nail salon for a $77 mani/pedi.  I kept reading the brand polish just because I like the color and how quickly it dried with the uv/led light.  Once I paid for my service, I vowed to do my own gel polish.  I will go for a plain mani/pedi and then do my gel polish at home!  I love this polish because it makes my nails stronger and the colors are so pretty and vivid.

I got this because I love the DND brand and every time I go to the nail salon they use the base coat and normal top coat(not the no cleanser) and i decides to give it a try to see if it works, and it did!! I was so excited after I was done curing them under my light to feel that my nails were soft without me having to do alcohol nail pads on them! I am so in love with it!

reviews.t: Nail Salon Quality without the Nail Salon Price
reviews.x: Very happy with these gel top and base coats. Way better than the other brand I’ve used. These are the kind that are used in nail shops and they work really well with the UV/LED lamp I have (its 36 watts). It provides a beautiful shine when dry and is no wipe top coat. These bottles are pretty big and have a lot of fluid within so you’re not getting gypped.

I've been getting my nails done at the salon for the last 6 years. Due to COVID and salons shutting down I decided it was time I start doing them myself. I bought the no-cleanse top coat out of pure laziness and I'm so glad I did! There's a reason nail salons use the DND brand exclusively. It's amazing!

Absolutely horrible. I exclusively use DND polish and replaced my empty DND base and top coat with this...it’s terrible. The base coat is watery and the top coat is gummy AND it started chipping and cracking in under 5 days. I’ve never had any issues with my DND polish, but this is horrible.

The top coat for this product still has to be cleansed even though it says you don't. After curing the top coat my nails were still sticky and needed a clear shine top coat in order for that to not happen. Or, cleanse the top coat with rubbing alcohol.

reviews.t: It makes the nail polish glossy
reviews.x: The top coat makes the polish glossy but you have to be careful that you don't apply too much at a time. The picture taken is after 14 days of applying with lots of deeping inside water. The spaces on the nails are just signs of my nails growing.

Hice el pedido de los artículos que aparecen en la foto y al destaparlo me di cuenta que solo enviaron los top y no enviaron las bases... Esos productos se deben utilizar primero la base y luego el top, asi que no los puedo utilizar...

Although these work great with DND polishes for gel lamps, the top coat bottle is leaky. I constantly have to clean the bottle! It is also a learning curve to make sure you get a clean manicure— practice makes perfect beginners :)

[[VIDEOID:b6ffb37aa4112e6c5a7e453a3274914a]] it’s a top gloss for sure! i’m more into topcoats with a thick viscosity but this is by far the shiniest topcoat i’ve tried it beats valentino, ibd, and many others.
I was excited to finally purchase a gel polish for at home use. I opened the box to find, what appears to be, an open, filthy and smudged package. Even the bottles inside had something smeared on it.
I tried it for the first time at home and it turned out ok. I see them use it in the salons all the time but i couldn't get it to cure properly. I might just need to google how to cure in uv lamp.

claims.text: Many reviewers love this base and top coat, calling it the best they've used and praising its durability and shine.
Several reviewers report serious problems, including product arriving solid or not curing properly, and some question its authenticity.
Reviewers note the formula is thin and easy to over-apply, which can affect how long the manicure lasts.
Some users mention it feels hot or burns on the skin under the lamp, so careful application is advised.
A few reviewers had order or value issues, such as receiving the wrong item or feeling it wasn't worth the money.
